title: Joining Albert Wynn's band on saxophone
summary: In early 1926 he joined the Wynn band in Chicago, playing mostly saxophone though he thought his cornet better.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Okay, so getting back to -- now we're talking about 1926 --
Early '26, now what happened in Chicago, you were playing cornet, soprano and tenor --
-- in those days and you joined Wynn's Al Williams* band?
Yes. I joined Al Williams* band, playing saxophone.
I had my cornet, but I didn't play too much of it -- I thought I played better cornet than I did sax, but I liked saxophone better.
